tests.name: Public self-signup is disabled while admin-issued accounts need no confirmation email
Endpoint rejects missing/forged JWTs, student/reviewer callers and a foreign browser origin
Student provisioning rejects role injection, invalid passwords and inactive or missing courses
An admin issues a confirmed password account and enrollment without sending email
Duplicate creation preserves the original password and enrollment
Existing enrollment is idempotent; additional course uses the same account and password
Admin can reset a student password; old password stops working and staff accounts are protected
Direct provisioning RPC and editable user metadata cannot bypass admin authorization
